events.event: str, the plain text containing the event mention
events.source_file: str, path of the file where the event appears
events.event_location: tuple(int, int), (index of character where the text starts in the file, index of character where it ends)
events.time_related_expressions: list[tuple(str, int, int)], a list of (expression, character_start, character_end), the expressions that determine the timing of the event, not relative to any other event

events.time_start: time_stamp (including XX if information is unknown) OR string indicating a reference period such as summer, winter, in his old days, at the end of the century OR Null
events.time_end: time_stamp (including XX if information is unknown) OR string indicating a reference period such as summer, winter, in his old days, at the end of the century OR Null

event_relations.relation_type: according to Allen's interval-based temp logic, one of 7: <before, equals, overlaps, during, starts, finishes, meets>
event_relations.time_related_expressions: list[tuple(str, int, int)], a list of (expression, character_start, character_end), the expressions that determine the time relation between the events
